title: Naive Encoding Bits and Two Meanings in Cross Entropy
full_prompt: Create a Manim visualization demonstrating the concept of information entropy and naive encoding. Implement a custom `EntropyChart` class that inherits from `VGroup`. The chart must display a stacked probability distribution at the bottom (using a custom or manual implementation of stacked horizontal segments) and vertical bars on top of each segment representing the information content ($-\log_2 p_i$ bits). The width of each bar must match the width of its corresponding probability segment, and its height must dynamically scale with the negative log-probability. Use `ValueTracker`s to animate changes in the probability distribution, showing how the segments and information bars dynamically resize and adjust. Add appropriate labels, reference grid lines, and smooth color interpolation between the bars.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing StackedProbDistribution class in standard Manim community edition
common_failure_modes.note: StackedProbDistribution is a custom 3b1b class. If porting to ManimCE, it must be manually implemented using standard VGroups and Rectangles.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Division by zero or log of zero in dynamic bar height calculation
common_failure_modes.note: If a ValueTracker goes to 0, -log2(p) will approach infinity. Ensure trackers are bounded away from 0.
